statement: For non-negative means and constant epsilon>0, an independent-Gaussian variance allocation can be found in polynomial time with objective at least OPT-epsilon.
algorithm: Enumerate support bounded by ceil(epsilon^-2), standard deviations on the epsilon^3 grid, and return the best expected maximum.
verdict_rule: Require distinct PTAS structure, exact variance feasibility, certified OPT upper bounds on finite cases, independent quadrature, scaling, proof calibration, and rejection of an OPT-like substitute.
